## Summary

Solution written to `/home/kara/SOLUTION-go-test-utc-midnight-budget-window.md`.

**Note on verification scope:** the scheduler source repo isn't checked out in this environment (only Go toolchain files exist), so I couldn't run `go test` against the real tree. To keep the solution genuinely verified rather than theoretical, I reconstructed the exact described pieces (`LoadBudgetSpends` in `budget.go`, `scheduler.UTCDayStart`, and the `julianday`-based predicate) into a minimal Go module and proved both the bug and the fix:

- **Buggy repro** (`now.Add(-2h)` / `now.Add(-1h)`): at `00:30Z` → `0.00s`, at `01:30Z` → `2.25s` (the exact reported `2.25 vs 6.25`), at `12:00Z` → `6.25s`. This explains both the flake and why CI (runs at 18:56Z/22:51Z) stayed green.
- **Fixed version** (`scheduler.UTCDayStart(now).Add(+1h/+2h)`): `spent_daily = 6.25` at **every** swept `(hour, minute)` of the UTC day, including the `00:00–02:00` window that was failing. All tests pass.

The key insight captured in the fix: anchor tick timestamps to the *start of the current UTC day* rather than negative offsets from `now`, so `spawned_at` always stays inside the active window. This is safe because the predicate only has a lower bound (`julianday(spawned_at) >= julianday(UTCDayStart(now))`), so future `spawned_at` values are fine.

The markdown is self-contained: title, root cause (with a boundary table), the exact code fix, verification commands (`go test -count=1 -run TestSchedulerGap066_ProjectsPayloadBudget ./internal/api/`), and a reusable detection heuristic.

signatures.description: TestSchedGap066_ProjectsPayloadBudget failed fresh runs 00:00-02:00 UTC (spent_daily 2.25 vs 6.25): test inserted ticks at now.Add(-2h)/now.Add(-1h) while the daily budget window resets at UTC midnight (julianday(spawned_at) >= julianday(UTCDayStart(now)) in LoadBudgetSpends, budget.go) — the -2h tick crossed the boundary and dropped out. CI stayed green because runs (18:56Z/22:51Z) never hit the window; gitreins guard also passed (diff-scope ran no tests with a clean tree). Fix: anchor tick times to scheduler.UTCDayStart(now)+1h/+2h (always inside the current UTC day, future spawned_at is fine — no upper bound on the predicate). Verify with go test -count=1 -run TestSchedGap066_ProjectsPayloadBudget ./internal/api/ inside the window. Detection heuristic: budget/date-window assertions using time.Now()-relative offsets + a UTC-midnight window boundary = run-at-any-hour flaky.
